slides.title: Adrenal gland
slides.description: A section across the adrenal gland, showing the capsule, the three zones of the cortex and the medulla with its veins.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-PLZ6-0225), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Pancreas
slides.description: Lobules of exocrine acini with pale islets of Langerhans among them, separated by septa that carry ducts, blood vessels and fat.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-OHPM-1025), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Pituitary gland
slides.description: The anterior pituitary (adenohypophysis, left) and the posterior pituitary (neurohypophysis, right), which in this specimen were cut as two pieces side by side.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-16XZZ-3125), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Thyroid gland
slides.description: Follicles of many sizes, each a ring of follicular cells around pink colloid.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-1OFPY-1525), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Aorta
slides.description: The wall of an elastic artery, from the intima on one side to the adventitia on the other.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-OHPK-0425), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Coronary artery (atherosclerosis)
slides.description: A coronary artery cut across, with atherosclerosis: the intima is thickened all the way round, and much more on one side, where a plaque with inflammatory cells and foam cells has formed. The lumen is still wide.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-O5YU-0725), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Heart (left ventricle)
slides.description: Cardiac muscle cut in different planes: branching cells with central nuclei, connective tissue and many capillaries.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-13O61-0525), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Muscular artery (tibial)
slides.description: A medium-sized muscular artery cut across.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-RU72-1225), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Lung
slides.description: Lung tissue with a large bronchiole and the branch of the pulmonary artery that runs beside it, among alveoli (some of them collapsed, as is common after death).
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-WFG7-0525), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Kidney (cortex)
slides.description: The renal cortex: renal corpuscles among proximal and distal convoluted tubules.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-1497J-0825), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Urinary bladder
slides.description: The bladder wall: urothelium (transitional epithelium), lamina propria and bundles of detrusor smooth muscle.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-OOBK-1925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Colon (transverse)
slides.description: The wall of the large intestine: straight crypts full of goblet cells, no villi, and the muscle coat.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-SE5C-1525), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Liver
slides.description: Plates of hepatocytes radiating from central veins, with portal tracts at the corners of the lobules.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-RWSA-1425), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Minor salivary gland
slides.description: Small salivary glands: mucous acini with pale cells, serous cells and ducts.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-11P82-0925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Oesophagus (mucosa)
slides.description: The lining of the oesophagus: stratified squamous epithelium, lamina propria, muscularis mucosae and submucosa.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-S4Q7-0625), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Small intestine (ileum)
slides.description: Villi and crypts of the ileum, with lymphoid follicles in the mucosa.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-111YS-1425), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Stomach (body)
slides.description: The full thickness of the stomach wall: gastric (oxyntic) mucosa, submucosa and muscularis externa.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-Y8E4-1526), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Skeletal muscle
slides.description: Fascicles of skeletal muscle fibres: long, unbranched cells with many nuclei at their edges.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-WFON-2325), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Smooth muscle (oesophagus)
slides.description: The muscle coat (muscularis externa) of the oesophagus: bundles of smooth muscle cut lengthways and across.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-131XF-0925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Cerebellum
slides.description: Cerebellar folia: the molecular layer, the Purkinje cells and the granular layer around white matter.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-1399T-3125), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Peripheral nerve (tibial)
slides.description: A large nerve cut across, with many fascicles of nerve fibres, each wrapped in perineurium.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-TKQ1-1325), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Spleen
slides.description: White pulp (lymphoid tissue around central arterioles) and red pulp (full of blood), with trabeculae.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-WHWD-0125), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Skin
slides.description: Hairy skin: epidermis, dermis, hair follicles cut lengthways and across, sebaceous glands and sweat glands, with fat at the edge.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-1I6K7-1925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Breast
slides.description: Mammary tissue: lobules and ducts in dense connective tissue and fat.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-1IE54-0625), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Fallopian (uterine) tube
slides.description: The tube cut across: a highly folded mucosa in the lumen, with smooth muscle around it.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-S341-0825), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Ovary
slides.description: Part of an ovary taken up by one large antral follicle: a fluid-filled antrum lined by granulosa cells, with the theca and the ovarian stroma around it.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-PWCY-1325), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Prostate
slides.description: Glands with folded epithelium in a fibromuscular stroma.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-ZZ64-0925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Testis
slides.description: Seminiferous tubules cut in many planes, with spermatogenesis, and the interstitial tissue between them, which holds blood vessels and groups of Leydig cells.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-XAJ8-1325), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Uterus
slides.description: Endometrium (glands and stroma) above the thick smooth muscle of the myometrium.
slides.credit: Image: the GTEx Consortium (sample GTEX-11EM3-1925), via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. CC BY 4.0.

slides.title: Stage micrometer
slides.description: A stage micrometer: a scale 1 mm long, divided into 100 divisions of 0.01 mm (10 µm). Use it to calibrate the eyepiece graticule at each objective.
slides.stain: none (a drawing of an etched glass scale)
slides.credit: A drawing made for the BMS workbench (not a photograph). CC0.

slides.title: Haemocytometer (cell count)
slides.description: An improved Neubauer haemocytometer (chamber depth 0.1 mm) holding a suspension of cultured cells mixed 1:1 with trypan blue. Living cells keep the dye out and look clear; dead cells take it up and look blue.
slides.credit: A drawing made for the BMS workbench (not a photograph). CC0.
